violations.text: The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and/or other debris: - various shelves throughout - pizza prep unit/lowboy New Violation. Correct By: 06/08/2026
The coving in the various area are in poor repair (peeling from wall). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026

The walls near hand sinks (pizza prep and dishwashing areas) and walk-in floors have an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 06/08/2026

The door to the outside, located in the entrance, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 06/12/2024
The dumpster area has an accumulation of litter, leaf litter and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 06/12/2024
